# System Overview & Architecture Summary

**BlogSphere** is a high-performance, full-stack blogging platform that fuses the vibrant glassmorphism design language of **Soumyajit's Portfolio Design System** with the feature-rich reader and author experience of **Medium.com**.

The application is structured as a decoupled **Single Page Application (SPA)** powered by **React 18** on the frontend, communicating via a RESTful HTTP API & real-time WebSocket layer with a **Node.js / Express** backend, backed by a **MongoDB** document database using **Mongoose ODM**.

## Core Architectural Principles

1. **Strict Separation of Concerns**: Decoupled REST API backend and client-side single-page application.
2. **State Context Layering**: Global authentication and design system theme states isolated into dedicated React Context providers (`AuthContext`, `ThemeContext`).
3. **Cosmic Editorial Design System**: CSS Custom Properties enforcing dynamic theme switching (Cosmic Light vs. Cosmic Dark mode), glassmorphism effects, gradient glows, elevation scales (`--shadow-sm/md/lg`), motion tokens, and custom typography stacks (Inter & Source Serif 4).
4. **Medium-Inspired Micro-Interactions**: Multi-clap counter (up to 50 claps per user per post with Map-backed Mongoose schema), slide-out comment drawer, floating toolbar, tag filtering, reading progress meter, and personalized feed generation.
5. **Real-time & Optimistic UI**: WebSocket/SSE channel for instant notifications and claps paired with client-side optimistic UI updates for claps, bookmarks, follows, and reactions.
6. **Secure Authentication & Ownership Enforcement**: JWT-based session management stored in `localStorage` paired with middleware checking resource ownership on update/delete operations.

# Database Architecture & Schemas (MongoDB / Mongoose)

The persistence layer consists of 9 collections defined via Mongoose models.

## Entity Relationship Diagram (ERD)

```
       +-------------------+
       |       User        |
       +-------------------+
       | _id (PK)          |<------------------------------------+
       | name, email, pass |                                     |
       | avatar, bio, etc. |                                     |
       +---------+---------+                                     |
                 |                                               |
       +---------+--------------------+                          |
       |                              | (Author/CoAuthor)        | (Follower / Following)
       v                              v                          |
+------+------------+      +----------+---------+       +--------+----------+
|      Series       |      |       Post        |       |      Follow       |
+-------------------+      +-------------------+       +-------------------+
| _id (PK)          |      | _id (PK)          |       | _id (PK)          |
| title, description|      | title, content    |       | follower (FK User)|
| author (FK User)  |      | author (FK User)  |       | following(FK User)|
| posts [FK Post]   |      | series (FK Series)|       +-------------------+
+-------------------+      | claps, reactions  |
                           | status, publishAt |
                           +----+----------+---+
                                |          |
                    (1:N Post)  |          | (1:N Bookmark)
                                v          v
                   +------------+---+    +-+-----------------+
                   |    Comment     |    |     Bookmark      |
                   +----------------+    +-------------------+
                   | _id (PK)       |    | _id (PK)          |
                   | post (FK Post) |    | user (FK User)    |
                   | author(FK User)|    | post (FK Post)    |
                   | content, likes |    +-------------------+
                   | parentComment  |
                   +----------------+

     +-----------------------+           +-----------------------+
     |     Notification      |           |       TagFollow       |
     +-----------------------+           +-----------------------+
     | _id (PK)              |           | _id (PK)              |
     | recipient (FK User)   |           | user (FK User)        |
     | actor (FK User)       |           | tag (String)          |
     | type, post, read      |           +-----------------------+
     +-----------------------+
```

## Detailed Collection Specifications

### Core Collections

#### `User` Collection (`backend/models/User.js`)
```javascript
const UserSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    name:       { type: String, required: true, trim: true, maxlength: 50 },
    email:      { type: String, required: true, unique: true, lowercase: true },
    password:   { type: String, required: true, minlength: 6, select: false },
    avatar:     { type: String, default: '' },
    bio:        { type: String, maxlength: 200, default: '' },
    headline:   { type: String, maxlength: 100, default: '' },
    website:    { type: String, default: '' },
    twitter:    { type: String, default: '' },
    role:       { type: String, enum: ['user', 'admin'], default: 'user' },
  },
  { timestamps: true }
);
```

#### `Post` Collection (`backend/models/Post.js` - Including Addendum Fields)
```javascript
const PostSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    title:       { type: String, required: true, trim: true, maxlength: 150 },
    excerpt:     { type: String, required: true, maxlength: 300 },
    content:     { type: String, required: true },
    coverImage:  { type: String, default: '' },
    author:      { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User', required: true },
    tags:        { type: [String], default: [] },
    claps:       { type: Map, of: Number, default: {} }, // Map of userId -> clapCount (1 to 50)
    viewCount:   { type: Number, default: 0 },
    featured:    { type: Boolean, default: false },
    readTime:    { type: Number, default: 1 },
    published:   { type: Boolean, default: true },
    // Addendum Extensions
    series:      { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'Series', default: null },
    seriesOrder: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    coAuthors:  [{ type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User' }],
    publishAt:   { type: Date, default: null },
    reactions:   { type: Map, of: [{ type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User' }], default: {} },
    status:      { type: String, enum: ['draft', 'scheduled', 'published'], default: 'published' },
  },
  { timestamps: true }
);
```

#### `Comment` Collection (`backend/models/Comment.js`)
```javascript
const CommentSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    post:          { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'Post', required: true, index: true },
    author:        { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User', required: true },
    content:       { type: String, required: true, trim: true, maxlength: 2000 },
    parentComment: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'Comment', default: null },
    likes:        [{ type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User' }],
  },
  { timestamps: true }
);
```

### Addendum Collections

#### `Notification` Collection (P0)
```javascript
const NotificationSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    recipient: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User', required: true, index: true },
    actor:     { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User', required: true },
    type:      { type: String, enum: ['clap', 'comment', 'reply', 'follow', 'mention'], required: true },
    post:      { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'Post' },
    comment:   { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'Comment' },
    read:      { type: Boolean, default: false },
  },
  { timestamps: true }
);

NotificationSchema.index({ recipient: 1, read: 1, createdAt: -1 });
```

#### `Series` Collection (P1)
```javascript
const SeriesSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    title:       { type: String, required: true, maxlength: 120 },
    description: { type: String, maxlength: 300 },
    coverImage:  { type: String, default: '' },
    author:      { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User', required: true },
    posts:       [{ type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'Post' }], // Ordered sequence
  },
  { timestamps: true }
);
```

#### `TagFollow` Collection (P1)
```javascript
const TagFollowSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    user: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User', required: true },
    tag:  { type: String, required: true, lowercase: true },
  },
  { timestamps: true }
);

TagFollowSchema.index({ user: 1, tag: 1 }, { unique: true });
```

#### `Report` Collection (P1/P2)
```javascript
const ReportSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    reporter:   { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User', required: true },
    targetType: { type: String, enum: ['post', 'comment'], required: true },
    targetId:   { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, required: true },
    reason:     { type: String, required: true, maxlength: 300 },
    status:     { type: String, enum: ['open', 'resolved', 'dismissed'], default: 'open' },
  },
  { timestamps: true }
);
```

# Backend API Architecture (Node.js / Express)

## API Endpoint Matrix (Core + Addendum)

| Module | Method | Endpoint Path | Priority | Auth | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Auth** | `POST` | `/api/auth/register` | Core | No | Register new user |
| | `POST` | `/api/auth/login` | Core | No | Verify credentials & issue JWT |
| | `GET` | `/api/auth/me` | Core | Yes | Get authenticated user |
| | `PUT` | `/api/auth/profile` | Core | Yes | Update bio, headline & links |
| | `POST` | `/api/auth/oauth/:provider` | P1 | No | Social login (Google / GitHub) |
| | `POST` | `/api/auth/2fa/enable` | P2 | Yes | Enable TOTP 2FA authentication |
| **Posts** | `GET` | `/api/posts` | Core | No | Paginated posts feed with search & tags |
| | `GET` | `/api/posts/trending` | Core | No | Trending posts sorted by claps & views |
| | `GET` | `/api/posts/feed` | Core | Yes | Personalized author & tag feed |
| | `POST` | `/api/posts` | Core | Yes | Create post |
| | `PUT` | `/api/posts/:id/clap` | Core | Yes | Send 1-50 claps |
| | `PUT` | `/api/posts/:id/autosave` | P0 | Yes | Lightweight draft autosave |
| | `GET` | `/api/posts/drafts` | P0 | Yes | Fetch author's unpublished drafts |
| | `PUT` | `/api/posts/:id/schedule` | P1 | Yes | Schedule post publication date |
| | `PUT` | `/api/posts/:id/react` | P1 | Yes | Add/remove emoji reaction |
| **Notifications** | `GET` | `/api/notifications` | P0 | Yes | Paginated notifications feed |
| | `PUT` | `/api/notifications/:id/read` | P0 | Yes | Mark single notification as read |
| | `PUT` | `/api/notifications/read-all` | P0 | Yes | Mark all notifications read |
| **Search** | `GET` | `/api/search?q=` | P0 | No | Unified typeahead search (Posts, Authors, Tags) |
| **Series** | `POST` | `/api/series` | P1 | Yes | Create post series |
| | `PUT` | `/api/series/:id/posts` | P1 | Yes | Reorder posts in series |
| | `GET` | `/api/series/:id` | P1 | No | Fetch series & ordered posts |
| **Tag Follows** | `POST` | `/api/tags/:tag/follow` | P1 | Yes | Toggle tag follow status |
| | `GET` | `/api/tags/followed` | P1 | Yes | List user's followed tags |
| **Analytics** | `GET` | `/api/posts/:id/analytics` | P1 | Yes | Post performance stats (author only) |
| | `GET` | `/api/authors/me/analytics` | P1 | Yes | Author total views/claps analytics |
| **Moderation** | `POST` | `/api/reports` | P1 | Yes | File report on post/comment |
| | `GET` | `/api/admin/reports` | P2 | Yes | Admin moderation report queue |

## Real-time Socket.IO Layer

A lightweight WebSocket channel mounted at `/ws` powers real-time interactivity:
- **Instant Notification Badges**: Emits `notification:new` to recipient sockets when claps, comments, or follows occur.
- **Live Clap Stream**: Broadcasts `post:clap_update` to clients reading `BlogDetail` for instant counter increments without manual refresh.
- **Typing Indicators**: Emits `comment:typing` in the slide-out drawer (`P2`).

# Frontend Architecture (React 18 SPA)

## Component Taxonomy & Addendum Additions

```
frontend/src/
├── components/
│   ├── Core Components:
│   │   ├── Navbar/            # Glass header with search & user dropdown
│   │   ├── Footer/            # Footer directory & social links
│   │   ├── BlogCard/          # Preview card with claps & bookmark trigger
│   │   ├── ClapButton/        # Multi-clap burst animated button
│   │   ├── CommentSection/    # Slide-out comment drawer & reply threads
│   │   ├── FloatingToolbar/   # Sticky bottom reading action toolbar
│   │   ├── ShareMenu/         # Social network share overlay
│   │   ├── TopicChips/        # Scrollable topic pill selection bar
│   │   └── TrendingPosts/     # Numbered gradient list of trending posts
│   ├── P0 Addendum Components:
│   │   ├── CommandPalette/    # Cmd/Ctrl+K global quick action overlay
│   │   ├── TableOfContents/   # Sticky section navigation parsed from post Markdown
│   │   ├── NotificationBell/  # Unread badge & drop-down notifications feed
│   │   ├── SkeletonLoader/    # Shimmer placeholders for BlogCard/BlogDetail/Profile
│   │   ├── AuthorCard/        # Hover card popover for author details & quick follow
│   │   ├── SearchTypeahead/   # Debounced live search modal dropdown
│   │   ├── DraftAutosaveIndicator/ # Draft autosave status pill
│   │   ├── EmptyState/        # Standardized illustration states for empty feeds
│   │   └── MobileBottomNav/   # Fixed bottom tab bar for mobile viewports
│   └── P1/P2 Addendum Components:
│       ├── HighlightToComment/# Inline text selection comment popover
│       ├── EmojiReactionBar/  # Paragraph & post level emoji reaction bar
│       ├── SeriesNav/         # Prev/Next navigation bar for series posts
│       ├── PostAnalyticsChart/# Recharts analytics trends visualizer
│       ├── OpenGraphPreviewCard/ # Social sharing card preview builder
│       ├── TagFollowButton/   # Tag feed follow trigger button
│       └── ReportModal/       # Content flagging & moderation dialog
```

# UI/UX Refinement & Design Tokens

The **Cosmic Editorial Design System** is expanded with refined motion, elevation, and accessibility tokens.

## Extended CSS Design Tokens (`frontend/src/index.css`)

```css
:root {
  /* Surface & Background Tokens */
  --bg-primary: #fbf9f8;
  --bg-secondary: #f5f3f3;
  --bg-card: #ffffff;
  
  /* Brand Accent & Gradients */
  --accent-primary: #8a35b3;
  --accent-secondary: #c770f0;
  --accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #c770f0 0%, #8a35b3 100%);
  --accent-glow: rgba(138, 53, 179, 0.18);
  
  /* Elevation Scale (3 Tiers) */
  --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(27, 28, 28, 0.04);
  --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(27, 28, 28, 0.08);
  --shadow-lg: 0 16px 40px rgba(138, 53, 179, 0.16);

  /* Motion & Timing Tokens */
  --transition-fast: 120ms ease;
  --transition-base: 220ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --transition-slow: 350ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

  /* Focus & Accessibility */
  --focus-ring: 2px solid #c770f0;
  --focus-offset: 2px;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}
```

# Operational Commands & Execution Reference

## Local Development Execution

```bash
# 1. Start Backend API Server
cd backend
npm install
npm run dev      # Runs Nodemon on http://localhost:5000

# 2. Start Frontend React Client
cd frontend
npm install
cmd /c "npm start"   # Runs React App on http://localhost:3000
```

## Production Verification & Deployment

```bash
# Build React application bundle
cd frontend
cmd /c "npm run build"
```

# Conclusion

The **BlogSphere System Architecture & Feature Addendum** defines a complete technical roadmap for scaling BlogSphere into a state-of-the-art publishing platform. By combining the **Cosmic Editorial Design System** with **Medium-grade engagement features** and a structured sprint sequence, the architecture guarantees high performance, accessibility, real-time feedback, and safety.
